notes: Modified cash basis (recorded as cash). Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (pp6-7); business-type from the modified-cash proprietary statement Total column (pp11-12), which carries capital assets and depreciation, so business_type measure is net position. Statement Taxes 445,282 split by the fund schedules' printed tax lines (General p18, Street p21, Debt Service p26, TIF p30; ties exactly). Statement State revenues 352,442 split by the fund schedules' printed lines (pro-rate, homestead, property tax credit kept out of state aid; ties exactly; includes Street federal grants 1,175). Statement 'Other' 784,312 is mostly the public power district lease (General Fund 509,238) and is kept as one line. Transfers: governmental in 34,707 / out 272,224 (ARPA 222,224 and General 50,000); Water Fund receives 237,517. Business-type reported receipts computed (no single printed total); disbursements 753,177 as printed on the Statement of Activities (p2). Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1), which includes capital assets and debt. Detail: each governmental fund from its own budget schedule (pp18-30); the combined all-funds budget (pp15-17), the General Fund by-department schedule (pp31-32) and the nonmajor combining schedule (p33) duplicate those and are not recorded. Utility funds from the accrual-basis proprietary statement by fund column (pp34-35); the Sewer and Water fund statements (pp38-39) repeat those columns and the accrual cash flows (pp36-37) are not used.
